title: HMAG Recipes For NFF
description: Adds several crafting recipes for materials from HMAG.
body:
Does what it says in the summary. I threw this together because I wanted to befriend the mobs via NFF:Girls without having to grind a bajillion slime girls (ayo what) just to befriend one.

It's just a datapack so if you want it to apply to all worlds I recommend [Global Packs](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/globalpacks) by JTK222.
